_comment: Summer's PD Table / HTML Build config. Edit to add/remove sku_aliases, mp_overrides, or manual data injections. Reloaded by rebuild_pdtable.py and build.py each run. 5/19: after_sales_improvement field deleted - ASI source of truth is now Tracker col E (NPD/ASI). Blank = NPD, 'ASI' = ASI. Maintain in the Tracker, not here.
_sku_aliases_note: Tracker SKU -> canonical PD Table name. Used in rebuild gap analysis AND build.py tracker-row matching. 5/12: G4-AS=G4-LS (Cottee typo, PD uses LS); 9TW-V3=9TW-V2 (V3 is V2); DIS-V2-CA-CO=DIS-V2 (Tracker has CA-CO suffix).
_mp_overrides_note: PD Table SKUs to force-treat as MP (Project Released) so they're excluded from page1 cards. Use when PM split a multi-color umbrella in PD updates but Tracker collapses to one MP row. 5/12: RJ64-10 new colors (Tracker 'RJ64-10-new colors' MP covers 4 PD Table color SKUs).
_manual_additions_note: Use only when a project is genuinely missing from PD updates xlsx. Format: [{"_note":"...","skus":[...],"pm":"...","fields":{...}}]
